scope: Additive Royal Champion Royal Gem L1-18 active recovery and permanent bonus audit.
game_version: Official December 2023 launch and January 2025 announcement for February update; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Hero Equipment
facts: Royal Gem is Royal Champion Common active Equipment that heals her significantly and increases her DPS and HP.
sources.limitations: No current level table, activation event ordering, heal cap or stat stacking rule is specified.

sources.title: Hero Equipment Balance Changes!
facts: Royal Gem was slated for a buff, especially useful at early or low Equipment levels.
sources.limitations: The official announcement does not specify which numeric fields, their replacement values, or exact application date.

sources.title: Clash of Clans Hero Equipment Balance Changes in January 2025
facts: Its historical table lists HP 40-380 becoming 60-570 and DPS 20-105 becoming 35-120 at L1-18; those new values match the pinned raw series.
sources.limitations: The table is a secondary preview and does not report the active healthRecovery 1200-2400 series or prove absence of later changes.

sources.title: Royal Gem — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: Dated table confirms HP bonus 60-570 and DPS bonus 35-120 across 18 levels with matching ore costs.
sources.limitations: Does not publish current active heal amount, timing, cap or other interactions.

sources.title: Pinned Royal Gem Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: Pinned active healthRecovery is 1200-2400; HP bonus 60-570 and DPS bonus 35-120.
sources.limitations: Current active heal continuity and application phase are unverified.

derivations.result: Pinned HP/DPS bonuses match both the dated 2026 table and 2025 post-buff secondary values
derivations.method: Compare all 18 raw rows against the historical buff table and dated client-build display; retain catalogue provenance.

derivations.result: Healing is official, but pinned 1200-2400 current continuity and combat phase are unresolved
derivations.method: Distinguish the official effect identity from the raw historical heal series and dated page that omits healing values.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply 1200-2400 healing immediately on the ability command tick
rejected_inferences.reason: No source identifies current healing continuity, activation phase or same-tick combat order.

rejected_inferences.rule: Raise HP above maximum or revive the Champion
rejected_inferences.reason: Heal cap, defeated-Hero eligibility and revival are not specified.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the 2025 buff as an active heal increase
rejected_inferences.reason: The dated historical table changes HP and DPS bonuses only; active heal values are absent.

rejected_inferences.rule: Add HP/DPS bonuses without an Equipment loadout
rejected_inferences.reason: The active Royal Gem must be equipped, but no shared deterministic selection contract exists yet.

rejected_inferences.rule: Allow defending Royal Champion to activate Royal Gem
rejected_inferences.reason: The official Equipment effect description does not define defensive activation behavior.

items: current active heal amount at each level
activation command, first heal phase, cap, overheal, death and Revive ordering
HP/DPS bonus timing, max/current HP conversion, damage rounding and two-Equipment stacking
Pet healing, Phoenix, traps and simultaneous damage interactions
Viewer control/overlay, snapshot, replay and RL loadout state

conclusion: Royal Gem L1-18 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official sources establish Royal Champion self-healing and HP/DPS bonuses, and dated sources corroborate the pinned post-buff bonus table, but current active healing and deterministic activation/HP ordering are unresolved. No Equipment Core actor is enabled.
